sources.title: About Mistral | Open, frontier AI for all.
sources.notes: Company page with the mission, founding in April 2023, key dates and the three co-founders. Living page; content as seen on 2026-10-01. https://mistral.ai/about redirects (301) here.

sources.title: AI in abundance
sources.notes: Announces Mistral Small v24.09, the la Plateforme free tier, a price update and Pixtral 12B on le Chat. HTML title AI in abundance | Mistral AI.

sources.title: Au Large
sources.notes: HTML title Au Large | Mistral AI. Announces Mistral Large, a new Mistral Small and availability on Microsoft Azure; introduces the endpoints mistral-small-2402 and mistral-large-2402.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.notes: Living page; earliest entry January 11, 2024. HTML title Changelog | Mistral Docs. The older address https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/changelog/ redirects here (two 308 redirects).

sources.title: La Plateforme
sources.notes: HTML title La Plateforme | Mistral AI. Opens beta access to Mistral's API with the chat endpoints mistral-tiny (Mistral 7B Instruct v0.2), mistral-small (Mixtral 8x7B) and mistral-medium (a prototype model), plus mistral-embed.

sources.title: Le Chat
sources.notes: HTML title Le Chat | Mistral AI. The page now carries a banner saying Le Chat is now Vibe. The address without the trailing slash (linked from the docs) redirects (301) here.

sources.notes: Says Le Chat Enterprise is powered by Mistral Medium 3.

Living page; on 2026-10-01 it gave October 31, 2025 as Retirement Date for 1.0 and 1.1 (the date the docs models overview gives as deprecation date) and status Active for both.

sources.title: Ministral 3
sources.notes: arXiv paper by Mistral AI authors (v1 submitted 2026-01-13). Describes the Cascade Distillation recipe that derives all Ministral 3 models from Mistral Small 3.1, the 410M vision encoder copied from Mistral Small 3.1 Base, and context lengths up to 256k (128k for the reasoning checkpoints).

sources.title: Mistral Small 4
sources.notes: Docs model page; heading as shown, the HTML title is Mistral Small 4 - Mistral AI | Mistral Docs. Shows the date March 16, 2026, a GA badge, Apache 2.0, version 26.03, API names mistral-small-2603 and mistral-small-latest, 119B parameters with 6.5B active, modalities as icons (text and image input, text output) and context 256k. Its weights link, https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-2603, returned 401 on 2026-10-01; the public repository is mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603. Living page; content as seen on 2026-10-01.

sources.title: Models Overview
sources.notes: Living page; content as seen on 2026-10-01. Its Deprecated section (Deprecated and retired models) lists model, version, API id, deprecation and retirement dates in M/D/YYYY format, and the alternative. HTML title Mistral Docs. The older address https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/models/models_overview/ redirects here (two 308 redirects).

sources.title: Pixtral 12B
sources.notes: arXiv 2410.07073 by the Mistral AI team (42 authors). v1 submitted 2024-10-09, v2 (current) 2024-10-10. Section 2.1 says the multimodal decoder is built on top of Mistral Nemo 12B.

sources.title: Pixtral Large
sources.notes: Announces Pixtral Large and, in a closing section, Mistral Large 24.11. The HTML title is now [Deprecated] Pixtral Large | Mistral AI and the page carries a deprecation banner added later. The Mistral Large section says the model is available as pixtral-large-latest on the API, which looks like an error for mistral-large-latest.
